purpose: Qualify source-bound SAT-v1 projection and independent parser/non-OCCT kernel lift for every parsed AC1018 3DSOLID carrier in a second public 3D sample.

sourceBinding.publisherStatement: The official sample page describes all six drawings as drawn by the TrattoCAD team and identifies the house as a 3D drawing built from solids. It says three of the six drawings were drawn and saved with TrattoCAD but does not identify which files; the creation software for this exact DWG is therefore unverified.

scope.projection: Each exact source handle was projected alone to same-version AC1018 ASCII and Binary DXF. The existing selector freshly imported both encodings and compared decoded normalized SAT text byte-for-byte to the source SAT payload, including remapped identity and layer/EED field shape.
scope.wholeDocument: Not qualified; complete DWG-to-DXF conversion remains refused by unrelated opaque callbacks.

independentRoute.normalization: None; each exact source SAT-v1 payload was parsed directly and lifted.

validation.inventoryResult: PASS: 48 unique typed AC1018 3DSOLID SAT-v1 carriers, handles 0x2a–0x59, 227591 total SAT bytes.
validation.projectionResult: PASS: all 48 exact handles pass same-version ASCII/Binary projection, fresh readback, byte-exact normalized SAT comparison, remapped handle consistency, and layer/EED checks. For each encoding and handle, a deliberately incorrect declared-size field is refused while preserving a seeded destination; correcting the field and retrying through the same adapter succeeds.
validation.kernelCommand: For each extracted /private/tmp/trattocad-house-<handle>.sat, set LIBDXFRW_SAT_PATH and run cargo test -q --manifest-path /private/tmp/opencadstudio-p7/Cargo.toml -p ocs_acis --test libdxfrw_ac1018_sat1_probe -- --nocapture with CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/private/tmp/opencad-p7-target.
validation.kernelResult: PASS: 48/48 SAT 4.0 payloads parsed and lifted to one body each; zero surface/curve/reference loss and zero OpenCADKernel validation flaws.
validation.artifacts: DWG, extracted SAT payloads and DXFs remain under /private/tmp and the system temp directory. No DWG/DXF/SAT fixture was added to libdxfrw.
validation.pairedDxfResult: PASS: the official paired AC1024 (AutoCAD 2010) ASCII DXF contains exactly matching normalized SAT-v1 payloads for all 48 selected source handles; both files and all extracted payloads remain in /private/tmp.
validation.geometryResult: PASS: all 48 lifted bodies have finite kernel bounds and kernel mass properties; conservative AABBs, adaptive mesh-integrated volumes/centroids, and fixed-tolerance tessellated areas are recorded. Handle 0x2d spans exactly 10000 x 8000 mm in X/Y, matching the publisher stated 10 x 8 m dimensions and the paired DXF $INSUNITS=4 declaration. All metrics remain uncorroborated except this bounded dimensional agreement.

transactionControl.fault: Increment the first selected SAT payload range declaredByteSize without changing payload bytes.
transactionControl.expected: Writer refuses; pre-existing destination remains byte-identical.
transactionControl.retry: Restore the original range and call fileExport again on the same dx_iface adapter; same-version export and fresh readback pass.
transactionControl.coverage: 48 source handles × ASCII/Binary = 96 injected refusal and same-adapter retry pairs.

limitations: This is a second source-distinct AC1018 drawing from the same public publisher as the pulley sample, not an independently authenticated second producer/toolchain.

The website describes five true solids, but this receipt does not independently compare these 48 SAT bodies with native-source expected geometry, drawing placement, units, assembly membership, or displayed component count.
The independent SAT route does not validate DWG entity-to-AcDs association; the exact per-entity SAT payloads are bounded by the libdxfrw source reader and projection selector.
No native AutoCAD/ODA rewrite, native CAD import/measurement, platform qualification, or whole-document output proof was performed.
The paired DWG and DXF are both published by TrattoCAD and do not constitute independent producer implementations or native semantic validation.

The 10 m × 8 m comparison uses the publisher description and its own paired DXF unit declaration; per-body mass properties and mesh areas are independent kernel calculations but do not yet have external per-object expected values or native source measurements.
claimEffect: Adds selected source-distinct AC1018 SAT-v1 transport, per-carrier rollback/retry, independent parser/kernel lift for 48 carriers, and one bounded X/Y dimension agreement with the publisher description. It does not qualify an independent producer, exact per-body mass/area semantics, native 3D acceptance, whole-document closure, or general DWG/DXF/ACIS support.

pairedDxfBinding.result: All 48 source-handle 3DSOLID SAT-v1 payloads at handles 0x2a–0x59 decode byte-for-byte equal to the SAT extracted from the paired DWG. The published pair and output of the libdxfrw selector therefore agree on each exact normalized SAT body.
pairedDxfBinding.method: tools/research/decode_dxf_sat1.py selected each unique exact handle and reversed the group 1/3 SAT-v1 transform; cmp compared each extracted file against the corresponding hash-bound DWG SAT extracted for the kernel checks.

publishedDimension.claim: TrattoCAD describes the house as 10 by 8 m.

selectedDimensionComparison.comparison: The exact 10,000 mm × 8,000 mm X/Y carrier bounds agree with the publisher-reported 10 m × 8 m plan dimensions after applying the paired DXF millimeter unit declaration.
selectedDimensionComparison.scope: This checks one body AABB against a publisher statement. It does not independently verify the publisher statement, whole-assembly dimensions, native rendering, placement, or all geometry.

measurementMethod.kernel: Pinned OpenCADKernel 802f751 body_bounds and mass_properties; ACadRust SAT parser ce8a148.
measurementMethod.bounds: Conservative per-body AABB from the independent kernel. These are not exact face-by-face extrema certificates for every surface class.
measurementMethod.volumeCentroid: Kernel mass_properties returned values for all 48 bodies; analytic_mass_properties returned None for all 48, so volume/centroid came from the kernel adaptive mesh-integral path and are estimates, not independently matched exact values.
measurementMethod.surfaceArea: Computed as the sum of triangle areas from kernel mesh_body with max_angle=0.05 radians and chord tolerance=1e-5 drawing units; this is tessellated area, not exact surface area.
measurementMethod.overlapWarning: Per-carrier volumes overlap in the assembly and must not be summed as whole-model volume.

aggregateBoundsOfAll48CarriersMm.scope: Union of independent kernel body bounds across the 48 projected SAT carriers; includes eaves, porch and other projecting bodies, not the publisher stated 10 m × 8 m footprint.
